rationale.consistency: License headers, interface guards, module ID/registration, standard imports, Caddyfile parsing and nolint usage all match siblings; handler config uses time.Duration instead of the caddy.Duration convention.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles nil body, empty writes, chunked Write/ReadFrom, hijack cleanup, ErrNotSupported logging; but rate-only config (Timeout<=0, MinRate>0) yields an immediately-expired deadline, and negative Timeout is added into the rate allowance.
rationale.scope: Exactly the requested fields, options, directive, ordering and constant; no unrelated edits or refactors.
rationale.readability: Small focused types, clear doc comments explaining the deadline model, straightforward chunk loops.
rationale.robustness: Server-level default (1m) wraps inside the per-route wrapper, so the inner reset overrides the route's tighter deadline on every I/O; write deadline is never cleared after a request so a stale one can leak into the next keep-alive request when Go writes headers itself.
rationale.maintainability: Shared IdleDeadline/reader/writer types reused by server and handler; minor duplication of the wrapping blocks and no composition strategy for nested wrappers.
